issues.quote: Net income swung to $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023 from a loss of $2.7 million in fiscal 2022
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2022 net loss was about $2.7 billion ($2,722 million), not $2.7 million. The unit is wrong by a factor of 1,000.

data.summary: Nearly all figures are correct: revenue, gross profit, margins, operating income, 2023 net income and EPS. The one error is the fiscal 2022 net loss, which the analysis gives as $2.7 million when it was actually about $2.7 billion.
